title: ScalaHosting Review 2026: Plans, Pricing, Speed Tests and Black Friday Cloud Deal
excerpt: ScalaHosting is steady under load and starts cheap, but renewals jump. Here is the three-year cost, how it tested in seven reports, and the Black Friday cloud deal.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: ScalaHosting Review 2026: Pricing, Speed, Black Friday
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: ScalaHosting review for 2026: plan prices and renewals, speed and uptime from seven independent tests, SPanel, the Black Friday cloud deal, pros and cons.
meta.rl_answer: ScalaHosting is a steady managed cloud host with 100% uptime in four independent tests. Entry Cloud renews at $39.95 a month, about 2.7 times the entry price, and there is no AI builder.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is ScalaHosting good? | Yes for sites that have outgrown shared hosting. Four independent tests recorded 100% uptime, and two measured a 29 ms P95 response under load.
How much does ScalaHosting cost? | Mini shared is $2.95 a month on a 1-year term. Entry Cloud is $11.21 a month on Black Friday and $39.95 standard.
How steep is the ScalaHosting renewal price increase? | Entry Cloud renews at $39.95 a month, 3.6 times the $11.21 Black Friday price and 1.6 times the $24.95 three-year price.
What is the ScalaHosting uptime guarantee? | ScalaHosting's homepage lists 99.9%, with a service credit as the stated remedy, according to DigitalPrahlad.
Does ScalaHosting have a money-back guarantee? | Yes. ScalaHosting lists an anytime unconditional money-back guarantee on its homepage.
Does ScalaHosting offer phone support? | WPBeginner lists live chat, tickets and email. We did not find phone support listed.
Does ScalaHosting have data centers in Asia? | Its own data centers are in Dallas, New York and Sofia. HostScore measured 653 ms from Singapore.
Is ScalaHosting migration free? | ScalaHosting lists free site transfer. Check the limits when you order.
Does ScalaHosting have AI features? | It lists SShield, AI-powered security. We found no AI site builder or assistant.
Is ScalaHosting better than Hostinger? | ScalaHosting is steadier under load and costs more. Hostinger is cheaper, with more AI tools.
What is SPanel? | SPanel is ScalaHosting's own control panel. It is an alternative to cPanel and includes Cloudflare CDN integration.
Who should avoid ScalaHosting? | People who want built-in AI tools, the lowest price for years or phone support.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Two tests measured a 29 ms P95 response under 50 and 100 users.
Four independent tests recorded 100% uptime.
Entry Cloud renews at $39.95 a month, about 2.7 times the entry price.
There is no AI builder. SShield is AI-powered security.
meta.rl_r_verdict: ScalaHosting is a strong step up from shared hosting. Servers stay steady under load and uptime was 100% in four tests. The renewal price rises sharply, and there are no AI tools beyond security.
meta.rl_r_buy:
Your site has outgrown shared hosting.
You want steady speed under load and a managed cloud server.
You are happy to re-shop or budget for the renewal.
meta.rl_r_skip:
You want built-in AI tools.
You want the lowest price for years.
You need phone support.
meta.rl_r_pros:
Steady under load in two separate tests.
100% uptime in four independent tests.
SPanel with Cloudflare CDN integration.
Free daily backups, SSL and site transfer listed.
Real people on support.
meta.rl_r_cons:
Renewal prices rise sharply.
No shared hosting deal this year.
No AI builder or assistant.
Two places to manage: account and SPanel.
Few native data centers.
meta.rl_r_best: Sites that have outgrown shared hosting
